definitions.explanation: A person who sings. In traditional usage, refers to any singer. In modern internet culture, specifically refers to amateur or semi-professional singers who post cover songs or original music online.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{素晴|すば}らしい→素晴らしい：01119_subarashii⟧{歌|うた}い{手|て}だ。
ニコニコ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歌|うた}い{手|て}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A popular online singer from Niconico made their debut.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{民謡|みんよう}→民謡：07083_minyou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地元|じもと}→地元：09941_jimoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歌|うた}い{手|て}⟦によって→によって：06801_niyotte⟧{何世代|なんせだい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧わたって{歌|うた}い{継|つ}がれてきた。
examples.english: This folk song has been passed down through singing by local singers across many generations.

notes:
USAGE:
Traditionally a general term for a singer. In modern Japanese internet culture (since the late 2000s), {歌|うた}い{手|て} has taken on a specific meaning: an amateur or semi-professional singer who posts cover songs on video platforms like Niconico or YouTube. Many professional singers have emerged from this {歌|うた}い{手|て} culture.

FORMS:
⟦{歌|うた}う→歌う：00684_utau⟧ (to sing) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (person who does) = singer. The ～⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ suffix creates agent nouns from verbs (cf. {書|か}き{手|て} = writer, ⟦{聞|き}き{手|て}→聞き手：19792_kikite⟧ = listener).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧{歌|うた}い{手|て}: popular singer
- {歌|うた}い{手|て}⟦デビュー→デビュー：11016_debyuu⟧: singer debut
- ⟦{民謡|みんよう}→民謡：07083_minyou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{歌|うた}い{手|て}: folk song singer
